trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. Work through the roadmap in order: story chapters first, then the stranger mission strands, then activities and collectibles, and save the long grinds for last. The platinum unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the mission Gone Fishing and finish it. It is a story mission, so follow the story until it appears and complete it. If the attempt goes wrong, a story mission can be replayed from the mission menu.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Play through the opening missions in order until the chapter closes; the trophy unlocks when the chapter-complete screen appears.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion. That means finishing the story, all stranger mission strands, activities, collectibles and challenges the completion checklist counts. Use the in-game stats to see what is still missing, and work through this guide's roadmap stage by stage.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps and tricks done while driving or riding; repeat them across Leonida until the counter reaches 250. The description names no single place, so any stunt the game counts adds to the total.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade (count 250, as the description states). Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one of every activity the game offers — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games and the rest — until each type has been tried at least once.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Visit the Shooting Range and play every challenge until each one is cleared with a gold medal. The description names no single range, so use whichever range the game offers.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies: PSN progress target 42 Shooting Range challenges. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone race location and win the race there; the trophy needs a win at all of them, not just one.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races around Leonida and win 20 distinct ones; winning the same race twice does not add a new one.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade (count 20, as the description states). Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him; the description names no spot, so take the challenge wherever Cal offers it.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find each meditation spot in the state and meditate there once; the description names no list of spots, so explore and check each one off as you find it.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade (count 100, as the description states). Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade (count 50, as the description states). Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape without being caught. Do it with your partner beside you, or it does not count.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob a shop with your partner, then a second and a third in a row, keeping the wanted level alive through all three.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade (count 3, as the description states). Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.
